answer: The knoll index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the tundra queue while honest participants promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1267 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the hollow. The fee repeats 16 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
